name: ansibleguard/undocumented-complex-task
fp_root_cause: Fires on any task with a Jinja expression regardless of complexity; threshold too permissive — needs AST-based complexity scoring

name: ansibleguard/plaintext-sensitive-variable
fp_root_cause: Cannot distinguish placeholder defaults (empty string, 'changeme', '{{ var }}') from real secrets; needs entropy check + SOPS/Vault/Jinja awareness

name: ansibleguard/invalid-task-attribute-type
fp_root_cause: environment: '{{ dict_var }}' is valid when the variable is a dict at runtime; cannot determine Jinja variable type statically

name: ansibleguard/incomplete-task
fp_root_cause: Fires on TODO/FIXME markers inside YAML comment lines (#) which are not active configuration; needs to gate on non-comment context

name: ansibleguard/duplicate-task-names
fp_root_cause: Fires on intentional conditional re-use patterns (same task name used under when: conditions) — needs to check when: clause presence

name: ansibleguard/shell-instead-of-module
fp_root_cause: Read-only query commands (hostname read, timedatectl query) have no module equivalents; needs read vs write command distinction

name: ansibleguard/unnecessary-abstraction
fp_root_cause: Heuristic too aggressive; what looks unnecessary to static analysis may serve testing or reuse purposes

name: gitleaks/generic-api-key
fp_root_cause: Generic high-entropy pattern matches SHA-1 hashes, GPG fingerprints, and other non-credential hex values

name: ansibleguard/unnecessary-set-fact
fp_root_cause: Requires cross-file analysis to confirm variable is truly unused; include_tasks consumers are invisible to single-file analysis

name: ansibleguard/unscoped-shell-variable
fp_root_cause: PowerShell, csh/tcsh, and multi-line heredoc scripts are not distinguished from bash; shell-type detection needed

name: ansibleguard/incohesive-playbook
fp_root_cause: Same root cause as incohesive-play — cohesion metric is unreliable

name: ansibleguard/unused-include-vars
fp_root_cause: Requires cross-file analysis to confirm consumption; vars may be used in included tasks or role dependencies

name: ansibleguard/incohesive-play
fp_root_cause: Cohesion detection relies on task-name pattern-matching, not semantic task grouping; produces near-random results

name: ansible-lint/command-instead-of-module
fp_root_cause: Read-only commands and platform-specific wrappers (timeout, strace) have no Ansible equivalents; needs read/write distinction

name: ansibleguard/variable-use-before-definition
fp_root_cause: Ansible cross-file variable injection (set_fact in included tasks, group_vars, role defaults) is the norm; single-file analysis always FP

name: gitleaks/kubernetes-secret-yaml
fp_root_cause: Regex too broad; matches non-secret base64 config values in ConfigMaps

name: ansibleguard/broken-role-dependency
fp_root_cause: Likely Galaxy API lookup failure or missing collections in offline test env; all 5 sampled items were FP
